statement.p: Determine which of the following statements are true and which are false.

li.p: If \displaystyle A and \displaystyle B are square matrices of the same size then \displaystyle (A+B)^2 = A^2 + 2AB + B^2.
The matrices \displaystyle A^TA and \displaystyle AA^T are always square, regardless of the size of \displaystyle A.
If \displaystyle A \in \mathcal{M}_{n,m} and \displaystyle \mathbf{b} \in \mathbb{R}^m is a column vector, then \displaystyle A\mathbf{b} is a linear combination of the columns of \displaystyle A.
If \displaystyle A \in \mathcal{M}_{n,m} and \displaystyle \mathbf{b} \in \mathbb{R}^m is a column vector, then \displaystyle A\mathbf{b} is a linear combination of the rows of \displaystyle A.
If \displaystyle A and \displaystyle B are square matrices of the same size, then \displaystyle (AB)^T = A^TB^T.
